description: The account's recent activity, newest first: each UK screening call (time, environment, numbers checked, counts by outcome, campaign_ref, request_id) and each movement on the UK credit, AU wash and dead number balances (purchases, draws, refunds). Phone numbers are never returned. Page back by passing next_before as before. Needs the usage scope. Costs nothing.

before.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp with a time zone, for example "2026-11-02T09:30:00Z". Only events before it are returned. Pass next_before from the previous page.

limit.description: How many events to return, 20 by default and up to 100.

name: get_screening_history
title: Screening and balance history
